ques: Browse the Well-Being section filtered to the Sleep topic, open the article about how to fall asleep faster, and report the name of the doctor who medically reviewed it.
In the Health News section, filter to the Research & Approvals topic, open the article about RSV vaccines for adults in their 50s, and report both its published date and its medically reviewed date.
In the Diet & Weight Management section, filter to the Food & Recipes topic, open the article listed there, and report who wrote it and which doctor medically reviewed it.

Use the site search to find the article about how much water you actually need, open it, and report who wrote it, which doctor medically reviewed it, and which topic it is filed under within its section.
Search the site for the brand name Flomax, open the matching drug's page, and report the standard adult starting dose and exactly when the page says it should be taken relative to meals.
Search for melatonin and open the article about what the evidence supports. Report the name of its medical reviewer, then open that reviewer's author profile and report the credentials listed there.
Open the drug page for warfarin and report the three antibiotics that its interactions section specifically names as raising bleeding risk.
Open the levothyroxine drug page and report the category label shown at the top of the page and the conditions listed in its 'Used For' sidebar.

From the Migraine condition page, open the triptan listed among its related medications and report the maximum total dose in milligrams that page allows in 24 hours, and the minimum number of hours to wait before taking a second dose.

From the Atrial Fibrillation condition page, open the factor Xa inhibitor anticoagulant listed among its related medications, and report its standard dose for atrial fibrillation plus the three patient criteria the page lists for using the reduced dose.

Open the Gout condition page and report which diuretic its causes section specifically names as a risk factor. Then open the related article about gout attacks that is linked from that page and report who wrote it.
Open the condition page for Vertigo (BPPV) and report the name of the repositioning maneuver its treatments section says cures most cases, and the anti-nausea medicine it names for short-term relief.
Use the Symptom Checker: select Dizziness, Heart palpitations, Fatigue, and Shortness of breath, run the check, and report the top-ranked condition and how many of the selected symptoms it matched.
Use the Symptom Checker: select Fever, Frequent urination, and Painful urination, run the check, and report the top-ranked condition.
Find the author profile of the medical reviewer on this site who is board-certified in Gastroenterology, and report her name and how many articles she has medically reviewed on this site.
